# CANDIDATE: VIX_SPIKE_MEANREV

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A rapid VIX spike (>0.3 points in 5 minutes) with minimal SPY movement (<0.05% 5-min return) predicts short-term mean reversion in SPY. This edge exists because VIX spikes often reflect temporary order flow imbalances or hedging pressure that dissipate quickly, while SPY remains range-bound due to offsetting flows, creating a statistical arbitrage opportunity for mean reversion.

## Mechanism

Entry: Long SPY at next 5-min bar open if 5-min VIX change > +0.30 AND |SPY 5-min return| < 0.05%; Short SPY at next 5-min bar open if 5-min VIX change < -0.30 AND |SPY 5-min return| > 0.05%. Exit: Initial chart stop at recent swing low (long) or swing high (short); target at 1R (initial risk); runner trailed by Chandelier exit (ATR×2). Regime filter: Only active when VIX > 12 and time between 09:45-11:30 EST, avoiding major news windows (FOMC, CPI, NFP, mega-cap earnings).
